items.summary: How many lawsuits is that now? Universal Music and Sony Music have fired off another complaint against Suno for allegedly training on an “enormous number of copyrighted sound recordings” without authorization. items.title: Over 50% of a major streaming service’s tracks come from DistroKid – and other revelations from UMG’s lawsuit
items.summary: UMG's lawsuit accuses the DIY distributor of "deceptive trade practices and blatant copyright infringement", and of flooding streaming services with AI-generated "slop. Source

items.title: DistroKid’s $2 billion valuation based on it being a pipeline for AI slop and copyright infringement, says Universal
items.summary: Universal claims that distributor DistroKid achieved its recent $2 billion valuation by providing a pipeline for AI slop and copyright infringing music, to the detriment of artists and labels. It has filed a lawsuit accusing DistroKid of copyright infringement and unlawful deceptive trade practices

items.title: ASCAP names Jackson Wagener as Senior Vice President and Head of General Licensing
items.summary: He will oversee the team that licenses the organization's repertory of over 20 million musical works to restaurants, bars, fitness studios, live music venues, and other establishments that use music. Source

items.title: Landmark termination rights ruling not the “copyright emergency” music publishers claim, songwriter tells US Supreme Court
items.summary: When America’s Fifth Circuit Appeals Court backed a songwriter-friendly interpretation of the termination right in US copyright law, the majors bought the song that prompted that ruling and asked the Supreme Court to intervene. The writer of that song has now urged the top court to not get involved

items.title: AI-assisted streaming fraudster hopes to avoid jail sentence
items.summary: In March, American producer Michael Smith pleaded guilty to one count of conspiracy to commit wire fraud, following accusations that he had botted his way to more than $10m in royalties for his AI-generated music. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Split sheet firmado el mismo día de la sesión
tip.body: Los porcentajes de autoría se pelean cuando la canción pega, no cuando se escribe. Firma el split sheet con todos los presentes antes de salir del estudio, aunque sean amigos.

tip.title: Sign the split sheet the day of the session
tip.body: Songwriting splits get disputed when the song blows up, not when it's written. Sign a split sheet with everyone in the room before you leave the studio —even with friends.
